question:
A Zener regulator uses a Zener diode of breakdown voltage $V_Z=10\,\text{V}$ with minimum sustaining current $I_{Z(min)}=5\,\text{mA}$.

The input supply can vary from $V_S=14\,\text{V}$ to $16\,\text{V}$. The load resistance varies from $R_L=500\,\Omega$ to $2000\,\Omega$.

The Zener diode has maximum power rating $P_{Z(max)}=0.50\,\text{W}$.

A series resistor $R_S$ is used between the supply and the Zener-load combination.

Find the minimum value of $R_S$ that ensures regulation for all given conditions without exceeding Zener power rating.
